title: Recording the Collection Slot a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Customer Has Agreed To
content:
Where a customer asks for a day and a part of the day on which their returned item is to be collected, that agreement is put on the Northbeam Returns and Restocking authorisation as a collection request. The result the request governs is the notice the collection is booked at, which fixes the day the crew is to come. The earliest day the collection may be booked for is settled only after a collection booking naming the carrier that is to move the item stands recorded against the return with a last usable day that has not passed.

From the moment the request is raised, the collection stands as confirmed by the customer rather than pending, with no moves recorded against it yet, and the customer can see on the return the day and the part of the day they agreed to.

## Taking the confirmation

The confirmation is taken with `confirm_collection_slot_e0893723`, which is a tool of the customer's own: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. Only the customer may make this confirmation.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `return_authorization_id` | the reference number of the return authorisation the collection belongs to, read from the return authorisation record retrieved for the customer before the call |
| `pickup_notice_days` | the notice the collection is booked at, as a whole number of days counted from today, which fixes the day the crew is to come; a plain integer with no unit suffix and no decimal part, never negative, and 0 means the collection is agreed for today |
| `pickup_window` | the part of the day the customer has agreed to, exactly one of the four values below |

`pickup_window` takes exactly one of: `morning`, the crew comes before midday; `afternoon`, the crew comes after midday; `all_day`, the customer will be in all day and takes whichever slot the crew has; `business_hours`, a business address where the crew may come any time the premises are open.

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the collection request reference that was created, the day agreed as a calendar date, the part of the day chosen, and that the customer has confirmed it. The sentence appearing at all means the confirmation was recorded against the return.
